task_request:
I am an AI researcher and I want to maximize the impact of my latest paper. The paper source files are in paper_src/. Please create three outputs to help me disseminate my work:

1. Interactive HTML website as index.html with navigation and styling for online browsing.
2. Conference talk slides as talk.pptx with at least 10 slides: cover, motivation, related work, methodology across 3+ slides, experiments across 2+ slides with data tables, and conclusion.
3. Word summary as summary.docx with title as Heading 1, authors, abstract, key contributions as 3-5 bullets, methodology overview, and experimental findings as sections with Heading 2.

nodes.objective: Read the files under paper_src/ and extract the paper title, authors, abstract, contributions, methodology, experiment design, quantitative findings, and limitations into a source-grounded content brief. Preserve important numerical values and do not invent claims.

Create index.html as a styled, navigable interactive paper website with logical sections, readable typography, responsive layout, and restrained scroll interactions that improve comprehension without hiding content.

Create summary.docx with the paper title as Heading 1, authors, abstract, 3-5 contribution bullets, and Heading 2 sections for methodology overview and experimental findings, all grounded in the source brief.

Create talk.pptx with at least ten slides: cover, motivation, related work, at least three methodology slides, at least two experiment slides with data tables, implications, and conclusion. Preserve the paper's claims and numbers.
Check the HTML, DOCX, and PPTX open correctly, contain every requested section, and consistently represent the source paper. Report checks without changing outputs.
